journey.name: signin cold start
journey.description: Verifies that a sign-in link opened while Bitkit is not running waits visibly for the saved Pubky session, survives a failed session restore, and opens the authorization sheet. Precondition: an unlocked wallet with Paykit enabled and a locally managed Pubky identity, a requesting app (the Pubky App sign-in page) that shows a fresh pubkyauth://signin_grant link in the device browser, and a reachable homeserver and relay. Android only: iOS does not register the raw pubkyauth scheme for OS link delivery.

actions.action: Run adb shell am force-stop to.bitkit.dev
Tap the requesting app's sign-in link in the browser
Unlock Bitkit with PIN or biometrics when prompted
Verify a toast with a spinner reads Loading Your Pubky Profile (screenshot; toasts are not in the layout)
Verify the toast stays until the authorization sheet opens
Verify the authorization sheet shows the requesting app and permissions
Tap Authorize (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") and complete PIN or biometric approval when enabled
Verify the authorization success state is shown (id "PubkyAuthOK")
Run adb shell am force-stop to.bitkit.dev and turn off the device network
Tap a fresh sign-in link in the browser and unlock Bitkit
Verify Bitkit stays open and the Loading Your Pubky Profile toast is shown
Turn the device network back on within 30 seconds
Verify the authorization sheet opens without tapping the link again
Run adb shell pm dump to.bitkit.dev and verify to.bitkit.ui.MainActivityPubkyAuth is not listed as disabled
